model_turns.derivation: two pinned cases multiplied by two process conditions

attempts.derivation: one attempt for each declared turn with zero retry

concurrent_turns.derivation: serialize the four observations to avoid shared host and account interference

per_turn_total_tokens.derivation: warning remains below the failed 60000 reactive threshold; hard is the next 10000-token boundary above the observed 74324 average

aggregate_total_tokens.derivation: four declared turns multiplied by the per-turn warning and hard controls

per_turn_wall_time_ms.derivation: warning is greater than five full 55297ms repository verification runs and twenty observed 14600.5ms attempted-turn averages; hard is twice the warning

program_wall_time_ms.derivation: hard permits four serialized per-turn hard stops plus twenty minutes for setup and evaluation; warning is half the hard stop

per_repository_disk_growth_bytes.derivation: one quarter of the aggregate controls for four isolated candidate repositories

aggregate_disk_growth_bytes.derivation: hard is the next binary power-of-two boundary above the observed 304959488-byte Wave 3 peak; warning is half the hard stop

retry_count.derivation: the prior stopped run established zero retry as the accepted runaway-use boundary
